name: Sweden
genZNote: Sweden gave the world the Nobel Prize itself — funded by dynamite inventor Alfred Nobel's fortune — which is a genuinely wild origin story for the award now considered the highest honour in science, literature, and peace.

sections.heading: 🗺️ Geography
bullets: The largest Nordic country by area, located in Northern Europe on the Scandinavian Peninsula, bordered by Norway and Finland.
Features extensive forests, over 100,000 lakes, and a long Baltic Sea coastline, with Arctic regions in the north experiencing the midnight sun and polar night.
Most of the population is concentrated in the southern third of the country, around cities like Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Malmö.

sections.heading: 🗣️ People & Culture
bullets: Swedish is the official language; the culture strongly emphasises 'lagom' (a balanced, 'just the right amount' approach to life) and 'fika' (a social coffee-break tradition).
Known globally for progressive social policies, gender equality initiatives, and a strong tradition of design minimalism (IKEA is a global cultural export).
A significant global music export nation, particularly in pop production (ABBA, and Sweden's outsized influence on global pop songwriting).

sections.heading: 🏛️ Government & Society
bullets: A parliamentary constitutional monarchy; the King is a purely ceremonial head of state with no political power, while an elected Prime Minister and Riksdag (parliament) govern.
Known for its extensive welfare state model, providing universal healthcare, education, and social security funded through high taxation.
Maintained military non-alignment for over two centuries before joining NATO in 2024 following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

sections.heading: 🧬 Medical & Scientific Developments
bullets: Home to the Nobel Prize (funded by Alfred Nobel's estate), one of the world's most prestigious recognitions in science, literature, and peace.
A global leader in telecommunications technology (Ericsson) and has produced numerous scientific breakthroughs in medicine and physics.
Strong in green technology and industrial innovation, including major investment in fossil-free steel production.

sections.heading: 🌐 Global Relations
bullets: A European Union member and, since 2024, a NATO member, ending over 200 years of military non-alignment in response to regional security shifts.
Historically an active mediator in international conflicts and a major contributor to international humanitarian and development aid.
Home to the Nobel Prize ceremonies (except the Peace Prize, awarded in Norway), giving it significant global scientific and cultural visibility.

sections.heading: 🇮🇳 Relations with India
bullets: India and Sweden share an 'Innovation Partnership', with strong cooperation in clean technology, sustainable urban development, and advanced manufacturing.
Swedish companies (Ericsson, Volvo, IKEA, H&M) have a significant, long-standing commercial presence in India.
Both countries collaborate closely on climate action and industrial decarbonisation technologies, an area of shared strategic interest.

sections.heading: 📦 Trade & Economy
bullets: A highly developed, innovation-driven economy strong in telecommunications, automotive engineering, furniture design, and green technology.
Major global companies include Ericsson, Volvo, IKEA, H&M, and Spotify (a major digital/tech export).
A leader in sustainability-focused industrial innovation, including fossil-free steel and battery technology development.

sections.heading: ⭐ What It's Known For
bullets: The Nobel Prize, funded by Alfred Nobel's estate.
Progressive social welfare policies and gender equality initiatives.
Global brands like IKEA, Volvo, H&M, and Spotify.
Ending over two centuries of military non-alignment by joining NATO in 2024.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Sweden is a Nordic parliamentary constitutional monarchy known for its welfare state model, the Nobel Prize, and major global brands, having joined NATO in 2024.
keyFacts: Parliamentary constitutional monarchy; King is ceremonial, Prime Minister governs.
Home to the Nobel Prize, funded by Alfred Nobel's estate.
Joined NATO in 2024, ending over 200 years of military non-alignment.
commonConfusion: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, Norway — all other Nobel Prizes are awarded in Stockholm, Sweden, per Alfred Nobel's will.

highYieldFacts: Sweden: parliamentary constitutional monarchy; capital Stockholm; joined NATO in 2024.
Home to the Nobel Prize (except the Peace Prize, awarded in Norway).
India-Sweden: Innovation Partnership; strong clean-tech and sustainable manufacturing cooperation.
commonTraps: Assuming all Nobel Prizes are awarded in Sweden — the Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, Norway.
Forgetting Sweden's long-standing military non-alignment ended only in 2024 with NATO membership.
mustRemember: Sweden: constitutional monarchy, Nobel Prize home, NATO member since 2024, key India clean-tech Innovation Partner.
